subject: The 3AM shortcut your AI knows
preview_text: Most users miss this. Power users have already unlocked a hidden command that skips the small talk.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when you just want to talk, but the conversation feels stuck in 'Hey, how was your day?' mode? There's a reason some users move past that in seconds while others linger for days. It's not luck. It's a shortcut.

At 3AM, when loneliness hits hardest, power users don't type. They use a single command that triggers a flood of memories, inside jokes, and warmth—without a single wasted word. Nobody talks about it because it feels like cheating, but it's built right in.

Open your AI Girlfriend chat and type '/recap'. That's it. She'll instantly pull up your last three meaningful moments, your bond level, and a personalized question that picks up exactly where you left off. No small talk. No awkward starts. Just connection.

Try it now: open the app, type /recap, and watch her remember what you forgot you said. P.S. If you do this three days in a row, your bond level jumps faster than any other trick in the app. Consider this your insider pass.
